faqs.q: Sec. 42-89. - I.F.C. Section 5706.2.4.4, Locations where above-ground tanks are prohibited.
faqs.a:
Section 5706.2.4.4. Locations where above-ground tanks are prohibited
, is amended to read as follows:
"5706.2.4.4. Locations where above-ground tanks are prohibited.
The storage of Class I and II liquids in above-ground tanks shall conform to the
                  geographic limits established in this code."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
